admission.justification: The eviction cases exercise an active local path, a live builder in another process, a reaped process and ambiguous filenames with a live PID.

applicability: Cleanup of recognized knowledge-index build temporary files during cache eviction.
conditions: A registered local temporary path is retained.
For any unregistered recognized path, only ProcessLookupError from the PID probe establishes absence.
A live, reused or indeterminate PID leaves the file in place.
exclusions: Ordinary age and size eviction of SQLite files.
statement: Eviction prunes recognized build temporary files only when their owners are known to be gone.
